posts.cooked: Fun fact: I watched this today on YouTube (since I'm sheltering in place), and YouTube suggested that the next video I watch should be "Finch - Letters To You".  I have no idea who or what Finch is but clearly Google's content analysis game is on point.

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
Finch are a band, kinda post-hardcore. :B They're okay, imo.

I watched this one live, so I didn't have to listen today, which was good since it came out late and kind of bad since I didn't get a walk in like I usually do, but that's okay because I took a walk this evening to go to a friend's house because the power went out. D:

It's been a day.

posts.cooked: The letter about time travel amused me, because there are three Sentinels Live campaigns, two of which include Adam and Christopher as a GM and a significant player, and BOTH of those have a time travel aspect within the plot. So much for the timelines not being shattered anymore. I roll an Overcome to remove Voss’s oblivaeon barrier, I got a 1, what’s my major twist?
